sources.equations: GPU Gems chapter 1, section 1.2.3, Eq. 9 and dispersion Eq. 13: https://developer.nvidia.com/gpugems/gpugems/part-i-natural-effects/chapter-1-effective-water-simulation-physical-models
sources.orbitalDecay: Deep-water exp(k depth); velocity is the time derivative of the displaced particle position. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Airy_wave_theory
sources.waves: TUNING GUESS: deterministic small crossing waves, directions are compass bearings TO; not inferred from wind or measured sea state. Choppiness 1 gives circular single-component particle orbits.
sources.amplitudeScale: TUNING GUESS: range 0-2; primary period allowed 2-8 s. At minimum period and maximum amplitude sum(k A Q) remains below 1 (no overturning).
sources.pitchResponse: TUNING GUESS: pitchFrequency in rad/s, pitchDampingRatio dimensionless, pitchLimitDeg; no measured Laser wave response available.
sources.waterMesh: TUNING GUESS: waterSize, waterSegments, waterGridPower; dense near boat, coarse at horizon.
